name: Normalize video latent start (clamped stats)
plain: Fixes stat jumps at the start of a video latent by matching the first frames to the following frames, with the target clamped near the source so it cannot move far. Source stats are per frame over channels and space; reference stats are a single scalar over everything, so channel differences are flattened.
math:
μs,σs over dims (1,3,4)
μr=clamp(mean(ref), μs−0.3, μs+0.35); σr=clamp(std(ref), σs−0.35, σs+0.5)
out=(x−μs)/(σs+1e−8)·σr+μr
